chapter_title: The Language Movement (1952) and Road to Autonomy

questions.question: On which historic date did martyrs sacrifice their lives for the Bengali language in Dhaka?
questions.explanation: On 21 February 1952, Salam, Barkat, Rafiq, Jabbar, and others were martyred defending the dignity of the mother tongue Bangla.

questions.question: UNESCO declared 21st February as International Mother Language Day in:
questions.explanation: On 17 November 1999, UNESCO proclaimed 21 February as International Mother Language Day.

questions.question: Who placed the historic 6-Point Programme in 1966 in Lahore?
questions.explanation: Bangabandhu announced the 6-point charter of demands (Magna Carta of the Bengalis) in Lahore in February 1966.

questions.question: The historic 6-Point demand is known as the:

options.label: B
options.text: Magna Carta of the Bengali Nation

questions.correct_answer_text: Magna Carta of the Bengali Nation
questions.explanation: The 6-point demand laid down the constitutional framework for regional autonomy and self-determination.

questions.question: In the 1970 Pakistan General Elections, Awami League won how many national assembly seats in East Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Awami League achieved a landslide absolute majority by winning 167 of the 169 National Assembly seats allotted to East Pakistan.
